heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly cloudy. Chance of an early shower or thunderstorm near the international border, slight chance south to around Route 4. Areas of valley fog overnight. Lows from the mid 50s to lower 60s. West to northwest winds around 5 mph early, becoming light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Some early fog, then partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of an afternoon shower near the Massachusetts border, slight chance north to Route 4. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80. Winds variable to west at around 5 mph.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Chance of an evening shower near and south of Route 4, otherwise becoming mostly clear and cooler. Areas of valley fog. Lows in the upper 40s and 50s. Winds becoming light and variable.
